mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry or Companies House of the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague route: local notarization if required, then Apostille by the foreign jurisdiction's designated Competent Authority, then direct submission to SAMR. Non-Hague route: local notarization, local Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, then consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in that jurisdiction. Never chain apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of Companies or equivalent authority of the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague route: Apostille by the foreign jurisdiction's designated Competent Authority; direct use in China. Non-Hague route: local authentication and consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in the foreign jurisdiction. The routes are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Board Resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague route: notarize the board resolution in the shareholder jurisdiction, then Apostille by the shareholder jurisdiction's Competent Authority; submit to SAMR. Non-Hague route: notarization, then local state authentication, then consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate. No sequential combination with Apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association and Memorandum of Association of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate shareholder or its registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague route: Apostille by the shareholder jurisdiction's Competent Authority after any required notarization; acceptance in China. Non-Hague route: local notarization and authentication followed by Chinese consular legalization only. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel paths.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague route: sign and notarize bank officer's signature, then Apostille by the bank's jurisdiction Competent Authority; direct bank use in China. Non-Hague route: notarize, authenticate locally, then obtain Chinese consular legalization. Never apply both routes to the same document.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, supervisors, senior managers, UBOs holding at least 25 percent, authorized signatories, agents, and counterparties against the UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU and UK consolidated sanctions, PRC Ministry of Public Security lists, and PBOC enhanced due diligence databases. All foreign PEPs, their family members and close associates must receive enhanced due diligence regardless of ownership threshold. Screening must be performed before onboarding, at incorporation, and continuously before every wire transfer or PayPal settlement. Complete audit trails must be retained for at least five years under PRC AML law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System and National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The JV name must follow the four-tier statutory structure: administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry operating characteristic plus organization form, all in simplified Chinese characters. The trade name must be in standard Chinese; no Pinyin-only names are acceptable. The foreign shareholder may file a phonetic transliteration of its foreign name, but the Chinese name is authoritative for all registration, tax, banking, and enforcement purposes. Consistency between the Chinese name and the English/Pinyin transliteration must be documented.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon SAMR portal rejection, download the written rejection reason and rejection code. Correct the offending name elements and re-submit electronically through the same name-declaration portal. If the applicant contests the rejection, file an administrative reconsideration application with the superior Market Supervision Administration or the same-level people's government within 60 days of written notification. If reconsideration is unsuccessful, file an administrative lawsuit with the competent people's court within six months. Name reservation validity is 30 days and cannot be extended; reapply for a new name before expiry or immediately after a final rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Rejected for an operating Sino-foreign equity joint venture in the game 3D art outsourcing industry. SAMR requires a fixed lawful registered office evidenced by an ownership certificate or a registered lease agreement. The State Taxation Administration and municipal tax bureaus require a physical office for tax registration and invoice management. Corporate banks conduct physical site verification before opening accounts and reject commercial-mailbox-only addresses. A virtual office can also trigger liability for false registration and deregistration. The JV must lease or own dedicated physical premises appropriate for the headcount, 3D workstations, rendering hardware, and data security obligations. Shared service offices are acceptable only if a direct lease and a physical office unit are maintained; a mail-forwarding address is impermissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for inspection readiness: (1) written lease in the JV name; (2) visible company name plate at the registered address; (3) full-time employees with labor contracts and social insurance; (4) workstations, rendering servers, and licensed 3D software physically present; (5) original contracts, VAT invoices, and bank statements reconciled with declared business; (6) no residential use prohibited by local zoning. Quantified risk: approximately 40 percent likelihood of an unannounced SAMR or tax inspection within the first 18 months for a newly established JV, and approximately 20 percent annually thereafter. The risk rises above 60 percent if the address is a virtual office, if payroll is below industry norms, or if invoicing appears disproportionate to physical assets and headcount.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), particularly Articles 23, 24, 46, 47 and the corporate governance provisions of Articles 58 to 72; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019, effective 1 January 2020), Articles 2, 6 and 31; Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746), Articles 5, 8, 14 and 24.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Market Regulation Administration having jurisdiction over the registered office, with the one-stop online application submitted on the unified National Enterprise Registration and Business License System or the provincial Government Service Online Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application Form for Establishment Registration of a Company, the Joint Venture Contract, the Articles of Association, the appointment document of the legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager, and the Uniform Social Credit Code application embedded in the business license filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. The PRC Company Law (2023 revision) imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital for an ordinary limited liability company, but all shareholders must subscribe to the registered capital in the Articles of Association and must contribute the full subscribed capital within five years from incorporation unless a special statutory exception applies. No blocked escrow account is required. A capital verification report is not generally required unless the registered capital is contributed with non-monetary assets or the local SAMR requests an appraisal report for in-kind contributions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Reserve the Proposed Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Registration Name Query and Reservation System operated by the local Market Regulation Administration in the selected city
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare three desired company names in the approved hierarchy of administrative district, trade brand, industry description and organization form, for example [City] [Brand] Art & Technology Co., Ltd. Submit the name reservation application online through the unified provincial Government Service Portal or the SAMR enterprise registration module. Enter the proposed business scope and the designed administrative division. The system automatically checks identical or confusingly similar names, infringement of well-known trademarks, and prohibited words. After approval, save the system-generated Name Reservation Notice because it is valid for six months and must accompany the establishment application. No notarization is needed at this stage.
required_dossiers: Prepared Provincial Government Service account with real-name Level 2 or Level 3 authentication
Proposed name in three ranked alternatives
Passport or national ID of the proposed legal representative
Initial statement of registered capital and shareholder nationality
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the system rejects the name, the applicant must read the machine-generated reason, revise the brand segment or add a distinguishing industry feature, and re-submit a fresh request. A manual review by the local SAMR officer can be requested if automatic screening is unclear; documents may be corrected online within five working days without administrative penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Authenticate, Apostille or Consularize and Translate the Foreign Investor Documents, and Approve the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in the foreign investor's jurisdiction, the PRC Embassy/Consulate or the designated Apostille authority, a licensed qualified translation agency, and the shareholders for execution of the Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign shareholder's certificate of incorporation, evidence of its directors and authorized signatory, and the power of attorney appointing the local registration agent must be notarized in the country of origin and then legalized with an apostille under the Hague Apostille Convention or with Chinese consular legalization where apostille is not recognized. Each document is then translated into Chinese by a translation company carrying a valid bilingual seal; the English translation in the present dossier is for understanding only and the Chinese version controls before SAMR. Simultaneously, the board must reconcile the Articles of Association with the Joint Venture Contract, including registered capital, profit distribution, board composition, management voting rules, and dispute resolution clauses. All shareholders execute the final Articles and the Joint Venture Contract, and each page should be initialed. There is no statutory requirement for a Mainland notary to attest the Articles, but local SAMR may ask for a notarized power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Foreign investor corporate registration certificate and evidence of good standing
Notarized and apostilled or consularized board resolution of the foreign shareholder
Power of attorney appointing the local filing agent
Certified Chinese translation of all foreign documents
English and Chinese versions of the Joint Venture Contract and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the consulate or apostille authority issues a query, the business team must correct the signer's authority or the jurat wording and re-legalize the package. If SAMR refuses the Articles, the shareholders may file a revised unanimous written resolution and re-submit the Articles online. Delayed translation is cured by engaging a certified translation company and requesting priority service.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Establishment Registration Application with the Local Market Regulation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration, the SAMR branch at the district or county level of the registered office, via the Provincial Government Service Online Portal or the in-person acceptance window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Consolidate the completed Application Form for Establishment Registration of a Company, the original signed Articles, the lease agreement plus property right certificate or building lease filing, the legal representative and supervisor identity documents, the name reservation notice, and the investor qualification files. File electronically through the one-stop platform and commit that the business scope is limited to creative game art outsourcing, 3D model sculpting, character rigging, visual effect design and related professional consulting under ISIC 7490 and NAICS 541430. After submission, the SAMR officer applies the registration checklist, checks for conflicts with business scope licensing thresholds, verifies the lawful use of the registered office, and verifies the legal representative's identity through the real-name verification QR code. If the registration is accepted, the system issues the Uniform Social Credit Code, the establishment decision, and the electronic business license. The applicant should not open bank accounts or engrave seals before the license is received.
required_dossiers: Completed Application Form for Company Establishment Registration
Original or notarized copy of the Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Registered office lease, property ownership certificate, or landlord permission letter
Chinese identity documents or passports of legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager
Name Reservation Notice
Legalization and translation package of the foreign investor
Statement signed by legal representative on authenticity and legality of submitted documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where SAMR issues a Correction Notice, the applicant must rectify the missing or inconsistent document within the prescribed period, usually three to five working days. If the registered office is queried, a supplemental rent receipt, stamp duty payment record, or an alternative lease instrument should be uploaded. If the license is suspended for suspected prohibited name or illegal scope, the applicant may withdraw and refile with a narrower business scope description or request administrative review before the superior SAMR.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Collect the Business License, Engrave Official Seals and Open the Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration, licensed seal engraving bureau designated by the public security authority, and the chosen commercial bank branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, download the electronic business license from the SAMR app or collect the paper license at the window. Bring the business license and legal representative identity to a licensed public security bureau-designated engraving firm to produce the company seal, financial seal, tax invoice seal, legal representative name seal and contract seal. The seal engraving firm files each seal specimen with the public security database. Thereafter, the legal representative appears in person at the chosen bank to open the capital contribution basic account, and the bank will perform due diligence on the ultimate beneficial owner, business scope, and the board resolution authorizing the two signatories. Once the account is open, share subscription funds should be remitted and the bank receipt retained as proof of capital contribution. No foreign exchange bank may be designated until the foreign shareholder's funds are received and the foreign investment payment confirmation is processed.
required_dossiers: Paper or electronic business license and Uniform Social Credit Code
Legal representative original ID and passport
Board authorization letter and Pro-Forma First Board Resolution text
Bank signature cards and ultimate beneficial owner declaration
Seal engraving purchase order and public security seal registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal engraving bureau reports a name conflict, use the business license exactly and correct the seal template. If the bank rejects the account because of incomplete board authorization, the board should adopt an amended resolution containing the bank's required signatory list and provide updated minutes within two working days. A bank's enhanced due diligence referral is cured by submitting the full corporate register extract and a shareholding or beneficial ownership declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Post-Incorporation Tax, Social Insurance, Foreign Exchange and Foreign Investment Reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local State Taxation Administration office, local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, State Administration of Foreign Exchange authorized bank, and the Ministry of Commerce through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Information System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for tax registration through the nationwide electronic tax bureau using the Uniform Social Credit Code; verify the taxpayer type, small-scale or general VAT taxpayer, obtain the tax number and file the bank account with the tax authority. Register the entity with social insurance, housing provident fund, and payroll administration for employees, and complete the statistical registration. Where the shareholders are non-resident, the company must complete the foreign investment information filing on the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Information System and, if capital is transferred in foreign currency, provide the bank with the foreign investment filing code and open a capital account in accordance with SAFE rules. Finally, the accounting books and internal control system must be opened at the registered office; keep the capital contribution remittance advice and appraisal report, if any, with the corporate ledger.
required_dossiers: Business license paper or electronic copy
Uniform Social Credit Code
Shareholder identity and foreign investment filing code
Bank capital account opening certificate and remittance advice
Company seal and legal representative seal
Taxpayer registration form and commitment to use the national e-invoice system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau fails to load the registration data due to SAMR synchronization delay, the applicant must present the establishment decision letter and business license to the tax service desk for manual initiation. If SAFE queries the foreign investment filing, verify the industry code 7490 and correct the ultimate beneficial owner schema; the company may not remit any funds until the code is approved. Any missed filing deadline may be cured by filing a late-report explanation and paying the minimal administrative fine before the next tax cycle.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - no industrial licensing board or municipal agency is required because the entity is an office-based creative game art outsourcing studio with no factory, production line, warehouse, chemical storage or physical installation covered by ISIC 7490 and NAICS 541430.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no statutory operating license is mandated for pure digital 3D art outsourcing, sculpting services, character rigging and visual design consulting under the PRC Catalogue of Administrative Licensing Items; a standard business license and ordinary office lease are sufficient.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau are not in the approval path for an office tenant engaged exclusively in computer-based artistic services.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt. The project does not involve construction works, fixed industrial equipment, or release of pollutants from any regulated installation; it is a pure service and professional consulting operation under the Environmental Impact Assessment List of Construction Projects. No full EIA report, environmental impact registration, or pollutant discharge permit is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: None applicable. The studio produces no quantified wastewater discharge from manufacturing, no volatile organic compound emissions from coating or painting, and no hazardous waste stream exceeding the household hazardous waste threshold. Ordinary office domestic sewage and municipal solid waste are collected through municipal public services under the local sanitary code.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for a Civil Defense fire permit because the premises are leased office units, not a production or storage site. Nevertheless, the landlord must maintain a valid fire safety inspection record under the PRC Fire Protection Law, the office must have a fire evacuation plan, exit markings, charged extinguishers and emergency lighting; if the studio employs more than the local threshold or opens a public display area, a public gathering place opening fire clearance may be required. Occupational safety is limited to workstation ergonomics, electrical safety and personal data confidentiality because the operation is digital and consulting in nature.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, exercised through provincial and municipal State Tax Service Bureaus; the national online electronic portal is the Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) of the STA, accessible through www.chinatax.gov.cn and the provincial e-Tax Bureau service websites.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Sino-foreign equity joint venture established in China, the foreign investor completes the foreign-invested enterprise incorporation process with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). The Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed on the business license is the statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN), VAT registration number, and enterprise identifier for all tax administration purposes; no separate TIN application is needed for a domestically incorporated entity. Tax registration is completed through the multi-registration integration mechanism, whereby SAMR incorporation data is transmitted to the STA and the enterprise tax registration record is automatically opened on the e-Tax Bureau. For a foreign non-resident enterprise that has no Chinese establishment but derives China-source taxable revenue through services or transactions and needs a Chinese tax identity for withholding or VAT compliance, the non-resident enterprise must file a non-resident enterprise tax registration with the competent local STA office, providing notarized and legalized foreign incorporation documentation, board resolutions, the relevant cross-border contract, bank account details, and evidence of the Chinese withholding agent. The local STA then creates a non-resident taxpayer registration record used for enterprise income tax withholding, VAT compliance, and certificate issuance. In all cases, the foreign investor and the Chinese joint venture must also complete foreign exchange registry formalities with SAFE-qualified banks for outward and inward remittances.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under China's enterprise income tax framework. There is no US-style check-the-box or pass-through election for a Sino-foreign equity joint venture; the venture is irrevocably taxed as a separate resident enterprise on its worldwide income. A small-scale VAT taxpayer may voluntarily elect general VAT taxpayer status if it satisfies the STA record-keeping and accounting conditions, and a non-resident enterprise may apply the deemed profit method under an applicable tax treaty or domestic law, but no domestic entity classification election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: General VAT taxpayer registration is compulsory when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000 in any rolling 12-month period. Every Chinese-established entity must complete tax registration upon incorporation regardless of turnover; the threshold determines classification as a general VAT taxpayer versus a small-scale taxpayer. Non-resident enterprises with a Chinese VAT nexus and no withholding agent must also register for VAT in China.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China has implemented fully digitalized electronic invoices (full digital e-invoices) through the STA e-Tax Bureau and e-invoice service platform. Every invoice must be issued through the cleared electronic channel and receive a tax-authority-assigned unique invoice code and anti-fraud digital stamp before transmission to the buyer. Invoice data are transmitted in real time to the STA using encrypted structured data; paper special VAT invoices continue to require tax-control UKey equipment; red-letter credit invoices and invoice voiding must be processed online with tax authority verification. High-volume issuers must use official API integration, secured batch upload, or approved ERP-e-invoice interfaces; issuance of invoices outside the cleared fiscal channel is prohibited.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available to a general VAT taxpayer for direct exports of physical goods from Chinese customs territory, subject to customs export declaration, physical exportation, foreign currency payment from the overseas buyer, and proper input VAT tracking. For cross-border services, including qualifying game art design, 3D sculpting, and creative outsourcing services, zero rating or VAT exemption may apply if the service is supplied to an overseas enterprise, is consumed wholly outside China, is paid for in foreign currency, and falls within the STA-recognized catalogue of cross-border taxable services eligible for zero rating or exemption. The service contract should expressly state the overseas location of consumption, economic ownership of the service output, and absence of Chinese taxable use; otherwise the service may be subject to VAT at the applicable domestic service rate rather than 0%. Small-scale exporters are generally exempt from VAT on export sales but are not entitled to input VAT refunds in the same manner as general taxpayers.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bill of Entry) or China Customs export declaration form evidencing the actual export of goods from Chinese customs territory
Signed export or outsourcing contract and commercial invoice stating the buyer, goods or services description, quantity, price, currency and payment terms
Packing list and Bill of Lading, airway bill, or multimodal transport document proving physical export movement for goods
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or the equivalent bank-issued foreign exchange receipt confirmation generated under SAFE export collection reconciliation rules
VAT special invoice and input VAT deduction or export tax rebate calculation workbook supporting the refund or zero-rating claim

For services, a statement of work, service acceptance or delivery certificate, evidence of the overseas customer's non-resident status or offshore registration, and an offshore consumption memorandum or other internal support demonstrating use and consumption wholly outside China
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA cross-matches e-invoice data, customs export declarations, VAT returns, and SAFE foreign exchange receipt data. Any discrepancy between export value, invoice value, customs quantity, FX receipt amount, or repatriation timing will trigger verification, suspension of the export VAT refund, and an audit. Where zero-rating cannot be substantiated, the output VAT becomes payable at the applicable rate and is clawed back with daily late-payment surcharge; penalties range from 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under the Tax Collection Law. Falsified export declarations, forged FIRCs, fraudulent refund claims, and deliberate non-repatriation within the statutory deadline may result in refund cancellation, administrative fines, customs penalties, SAFE enforcement action, and criminal liability for fraudulent export tax refund under China's Criminal Law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese renminbi is convertible on the current account for legitimate trade and service transactions, including the import/export of goods, royalties, and cross-border service fees, subject to verification of underlying documentation. However, the capital account remains heavily regulated and controlled. Fund injections into a Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture as registered capital are treated as foreign direct investment and require a separate FDI foreign exchange registration with SAFE or an authorized bank. Dividend remittances offshore are permitted only after the completion of annual audit, tax filing, tax clearance, and submission of the relevant board resolution. Profit repatriation is not an immediate right; the enterprise must first verify the authenticity of the profits through audited financial statements and the local tax withholdings. The RMB is not freely tradable outside mainland China on a full capital account basis, and any cross-border capital movements such as shareholder loans, equity transfers, and liquidation proceeds must be submitted to SAFE for approval or filing. Foreign currency receipts from service exports are considered current account receipts and may be retained or converted, but the enterprise must document the underlying trade or service contract. Overall, the convertibility regime is moderate and functional for operational cash flows, but every cross-border capital movement must align with SAFE administrative rules and the domestic banking system's compliance framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's goods and services trade administration, the historical mandatory surrender of export proceeds has been abolished. Exporting and service-providing entities are not required to convert foreign currency receipts into RMB at a fixed ratio. However, all export-related foreign currency proceeds must be repatriated into China through an authorized domestic bank within the collection period specified by the underlying contract and, in the absence of a specifically approved extension, generally within 180 days of the export declaration or service completion date under SAFE's trade monitoring framework. The enterprise may hold such proceeds in a foreign exchange settlement account or sell them to a domestic bank at the prevailing market rate. Each receipt must be matched against the relevant customs declaration, contract, invoice, and receipt verification records in the SAFE digital platform, and any overdue collection must be justified and reported.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account (Capital Escrow Account) and RMB Basic Deposit Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Operational Current Account and Foreign Currency Settlement Account
RMB General Deposit Account and Foreign Exchange Operational Current Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital fintech EMIs such as standard non-licensed European/Singapore electronic money institutions are not legally permitted to maintain domestic corporate accounts for Chinese registered entities. Mainland China requires all RMB corporate accounts to be held with PBOC-licensed banking institutions or licensed payment institutions. International EMI platforms can provide ancillary payment processing for the entity's foreign-currency receivables, such as PayPal collections, but the funds must eventually be settled through an onshore partner bank in RMB or a licensed cross-border payment product approved by SAFE. These EMIs are not a substitute for a corporate bank account and cannot serve as the main treasury rail. The viability of using an offshore EMI is therefore low for primary account infrastructure, while the viability of PayPal as a sales-collection tool is medium, subject to strict reconciliation, tax reporting, and the limitation that PayPal payout is processed through a licensed Chinese partner bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture, the statutory legal representative and the financial controller must generally appear physically in a domestic bank branch for the initial relationship onboarding, particularly for the opening of the RMB Basic Deposit Account and the FDI foreign exchange capital account. Remote consular proxy opening is possible only for a foreign director or shareholder who cannot travel to mainland China, provided that the relevant power of attorney is notarized and legalized by the Chinese embassy or consulate, and the bank still insists on an in-person interview with at least one officer or representative with actual authority over the account. The majority of Tier-1 Chinese banks treat the physical presence of the legal representative as a mandatory KYC step; any non-resident director who will not appear in-branch must be supported by an original notarized authorization, a certified passport copy, and a corporate resolution appointing an on-site signatory. Banks may also request a video interview and an on-site inspection of the registered address when the business is outsourced digital services such as 3D art production.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity where the foreign shareholder of the JV is a non-listed private holding company with nominee shares and an undisclosed family trust.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide notarized and consular-legalized Certificate of Incumbency and Good Standing from the foreign registry; a chain-of-ownership chart tracing through to each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner; trust deed or trustee declaration if a trust is present; source-of-wealth statements for each beneficial owner; passport copies notarized and legalized; and a bank reference letter from the foreign shareholder's home bank confirming the shareholder's profile.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction profile mismatch in which monthly service invoices are relatively small but the initial capital injection is large, or where multiple third-party game publishers make payments that do not exactly align with the direct contracting entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the signed BPO master services agreement and detailed statements of work; the original game development and outsourcing contracts; publisher settlement statements from platforms such as Steam, Epic, or console publishers; invoice-to-contract reconciliation worksheets; SWIFT/ISO payment records from the payer; board-approved capital contribution plan; and the certified capital verification report issued by a registered Chinese accountant if capital is involved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential sanctions or high-risk jurisdiction exposure in the payment circuit, especially if payments originate through a fintech aggregator in a FATF grey-listed country without a clear underlying contracting party.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a complete sanctions-screening report for all counterparties, beneficial owners, and remittance sources; a jurisdiction risk questionnaire; a written compliance attestation from the foreign client that the game art is not destined for sanctioned entities or prohibited military end-uses; notarized end-user declarations; and a memorandum from a qualified AML compliance officer explaining the positive screening match and why the transaction should be permitted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Operational discrepancy where the registered business address is a virtual office and the number of declared staff is inconsistent with the scale of 3D art production, raising the risk of hidden subcontracting and undisclosed beneficiary studios.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a valid office lease or property ownership certificate; payroll and Chinese social insurance contribution records for all staff; a full list of subcontractors with their contracts and invoices; rendered-work evidence such as archived 3D models, rigging files, and art pipeline screenshots; certifications from game clients; VAT and corporate income tax filings; and an invitation for the bank's compliance team to conduct a physical or virtual site visit with the production team.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital for the JV must be injected through the FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account opened with a designated domestic bank after completing the FDI direct investment registration with SAFE or the authorized bank. The overseas investor will remit USD, EUR, or other contractually permitted currency by SWIFT MT103 or MT202, and the remittance instruction must clearly state the purpose as equity investment in the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture. The corresponding SAFE-approved balance-of-payments purpose code for foreign direct investment capital contribution must be used. Upon receipt, the bank will verify the amount against the FIE establishment approval, the joint venture contract, the negative-list regulatory position, and the FDI registration certificate. The capital must pass the bank's capital verification procedures; a certified Chinese accounting firm will issue a capital verification report confirming that the foreign investor has actually contributed the registered capital. The funds can then be converted into RMB or retained as foreign currency under SAFE rules, but the use of the capital funds within mainland China is restricted to the entity's actual operating purposes and cannot be used for speculative investments, foreign exchange forward bets, or unauthorized lending.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For service-based trade settlement such as 3D art outsourcing, SWIFT MT103 is the primary rail for direct telegraphic transfer of service fees to overseas contractors and sub-contractors. The payment must be supported by the service contract, commercial invoice, statement of work completion, and the required Chinese tax withholding certificate for overseas service payments. Commercial Letters of Credit are generally unsuitable for pure 3D art services but may be used if the contract bundles software development with tangible hardware deliverables. Documentary collections may be used for invoice-backed settlement in certain trading relationships, involving the presenting bank forwarding shipping or service acceptance documents to the buyer's bank against payment or acceptance. All outbound current-account payments are subject to audit by the remitting bank; if the amount exceeds a bank-defined threshold, the enterprise must provide the underlying transaction dossier. For third-party payments, the bank will require a legally justified relationship explanation and may reject payments where the beneficiary is not the direct counterparty listed in the contract.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign exchange forward contracts with a licensed Chinese bank, permitted only when the underlying exposure is a genuine current-account receipt or payment such as export service fees or royalty income, with the relevant contract and invoice lodged with the bank.

Onshore FX swaps between CNY and a foreign currency for short-term liquidity management of existing cash flows, provided the swap underlying is a verified trade or service transaction and not a speculative position.
Onshore currency swaps for hedging long-term service contract receivables or payables, executable only with a SAFE-registered bank and subject to real-risk validation and tenor limitations.
RMB FX options for buy-side hedging of foreign currency pricing in service contracts, permitted onshore with underlying documentation and no netting-only speculative intent.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards for CNY are prohibited for the mainland JV itself; non-resident counterparties may trade NDFs offshore only with the mainland RMB market not directly engaged by the JV.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (企业年度报告)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of each calendar year for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within the window results in placement on the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations; if unrectified for three consecutive years, entry onto the List of Seriously Illegal and Dishonest Enterprises, followed by administrative proceedings that may culminate in revocation of the business license; a separate administrative fine of up to CNY 20,000 may be imposed for concealment or false reporting, and relevant personnel may be personally liable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement and Payment Return (企业所得税汇算清缴)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 immediately following the end of the fiscal year; quarterly provisional payments must be reconciled annually.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a monetary penalty ranging from CNY 2,000 to CNY 20,000 (increased for severe cases), plus surcharge interest at the rate of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax amount; failure to settle due tax may also trigger tax-enforcement measures including asset freeze, bank-account seizure, and restriction on exit from China.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Stock Rights and Equity Annual Registration (存量权益登记)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through the digitized Foreign Exchange Service Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of each year, reporting the previous year-end equity, assets, liabilities, and operating data of the foreign-invested enterprise.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance may result in a warning and administrative fine of up to CNY 300,000; the enterprise may be placed on a suspicious list, which restricts cross-border capital movement, foreign-exchange settlement, and later foreign-invested enterprise filings; repeat or willful violations may trigger revocation of foreign-exchange registration and public disclosure of the violation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the PRC Company Law, every limited liability company — including Sino-foreign equity joint ventures — must prepare statutory financial statements at the end of each fiscal year and have them audited by a Chinese Certified Public Accountant (CPA) firm. There is no quantitative exemption based on turnover, balance-sheet size, or headcount; the audit is mandatory regardless of the company's scale, although small and micro enterprises may apply a simplified audit scope where permitted by local regulations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE) in the PRC, which are substantially converged with IFRS; eligible smaller enterprises may adopt the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (小企业会计准则) as a simplified yet legally recognized framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Owner Information Filing Measures (effective November 1, 2024), the company must file initial beneficial-owner particulars with the SAMR registration system, and any change in beneficial-owner information must be submitted within 30 days of the change. The Annual Enterprise Information Report serves as the annual confirmation mechanism requiring the company to verify its registered capital, shareholder composition, and equity transfer history for the preceding year. There is no separate standalone UBO annual return; instead, the annual report plus the 30-day change-driven update protocol together satisfy the continuous beneficial-owner transparency requirement.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors, and Senior Management Personnel
Register of Share Transfers and Pledges
Register of Charges/Mortgages registered with SAMR
Minute Book (shareholder resolutions and board resolutions)
Song of the Company Seal and legal-document receipt register

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 - 25,000 per annum depending on city, commercial district, and landlord terms (China does not require a separate statutory registered agent; the registered office lease is the primary cost)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - 8,000 per annum for a typical small/mid-sized Sino-foreign JV with no complex consolidated reporting, excluding any required tax-specific certifications.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: High-and-New-Technology Enterprises may use the 15% reduced rate. Small-scale low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million may effectively pay 5% for tax years 2023 through 2027. R&D expenditures qualify for a 100% super deduction. Newly established qualified software enterprises enjoy a two-year exemption followed by a three-year 50% reduction; certain encouraged free-trade-zone and strategic-sector projects may obtain 15% regional treatment. No general patent box regime exists in China; however, preferential patent-related income may be part of high-new-tech or software enterprise relief.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000, the Enterprise Income Tax Annual Filing (Class A), with mandatory schedules including A105000 tax adjustment schedule, A107010 exempt/reduced income schedule, A108000 foreign tax credit schedule, and G100000 related-party transaction reporting; filed through the China Electronic Taxpayer Station (e-Tax) portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement with quarterly prepayment returns.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly EIT prepayment returns are due within 15 days after each quarter-end; the annual Form A100000 is due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. on or before 31 May for calendar-year taxpayers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting revenue from selling 3D game assets, character rigging, texture creation, and related art outsourcing services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All export revenue earned by the resident Chinese JV is fully within China's corporate income tax net. The foreign client does not file this form. If a non-resident parent books the revenue and pays the JV a service fee, the JV must test that fee under the arm's length standard; otherwise the tax authority may re-attribute revenue under EIT Law Article 41. Non-resident suppliers or customers have no tax declaration on this line; their China-sourced income is handled by withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, rendering software amortization, purchased digital assets, outsourced art production costs, and direct project-related consumables.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to foreign freelancers or overseas BPO subcontractors must be supported by genuine contracts and service-performance records. Where the recipient is a related non-resident, the amount must satisfy the arm's length standard and, if China-sourced, may require non-resident withholding at 10% or a treaty-clearance prior to deduction. Inflated related-party costs are a primary transfer-pricing red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, property tax, stamp duty, and other taxes excluding CIT and income taxes on profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident CIT entry is made on this line. VAT on qualifying pure service exports to foreign game studios may be zero-rated if delivery and destination requirements are documented; domestic mischaracterization of cross-border services could create VAT fraud exposure and CIT adjustments if fake contracts are used.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, overseas client development commissions, sales staff costs, travel, and business development expenditures.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commission payments to foreign sales agents may be treated as China-sourced business charges subject to withholding if the agent has no business establishment in China and the China tax treaty does not allocate nexus elsewhere. Deductibility requires actual services rendered, supported invoices, and proof that the rate approximates an independent-party commission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 / Line 5 - General and Administrative Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Management, legal, accounting, office rental, and head-office or related-party administration fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party management fees are deductible only where the allocation is reasonable, the service was actually received, the Fee is at cost with no hidden profit to the non-resident performer, and contemporaneous documentation is kept. Merely labeling a royalty or profit-sharing charge as an administrative fee triggers denial, recharacterization, and penalty exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense on loans, guarantee fees, foreign exchange losses, and bank charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to a non-resident related lender is subject to 10% withholding (subject to treaty reduction) and must satisfy the thin-capitalization rule: related-party debt-to-equity ratio of no more than 2:1 for ordinary enterprises. Excess interest is non-deductible and must be added back in the tax adjustment schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest, dividends, fair-value investment gains, and proceeds from equity disposal reported in accounting profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received by the resident JV from another Chinese resident enterprise are generally exempt CIT; dividends from foreign subsidiaries may be taxable with a foreign tax credit. The JV's own dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are not deducted here; they trigger a separate 10% withholding obligation on the dividend payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Line 8 - Impairment Losses and Fair-Value Changes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Asset impairment provisions, expected credit losses, bad-debt reserves, and fair-value changes on financial instruments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Impairment on intercompany receivables from foreign related parties is deductible only when evidenced as actually irrecoverable and compliant with EIT Law deduction rules. Arbitrary provisioning against profitable overseas contracts will be adjusted upward and treated as income. Cross-border bad debts require formal debt-recovery steps and lender/customer evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating income before non-operating items; starting point for tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the JV reports persistent losses while related-party foreign affiliates earn high margins from its game-art activities, the tax authority may apply the TNMM or profit-split method to reallocate profit to China. This line must be reconciled with audited financial statements and the transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Government grants, penalties received, gains on disposal of non-operating assets, and other non-operating receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Government grants are taxable unless earmarked under explicit Finance/Tax Ministry exemption rules. There is no non-resident withholding on domestic non-operating income. Any non-operating income derived through or from a non-resident arrangement, such as settlement payments from a foreign partner, must be evaluated for China-sourced income taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Donations, uninsured losses, penalties, fines, and damages outside ordinary operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Administrative fines, tax late fees, and illegal payments are non-deductible. Payments to non-residents representing indemnification or penalty income may be taxable in China if sourced here; treaty-collection rules and substance analysis apply. Deductibility requires a genuine liability and proper supporting vouchers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit before tax per the statutory financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This line is the accounting bridge to taxable income. If the non-resident parent is in a low-tax jurisdiction and does not distribute profits, China's Controlled Foreign Corporation rules under EIT Law Article 45 may include undistributed foreign income of the JV, so the JV must report and evidence actual CFC exceptions where relevant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 13 / Line 13 - Tax Adjustments Increase / Decrease
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate permanent and temporary differences, including disallowed expenses, fair-value adjustments, and transfer-pricing corrections.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The A105000 schedule must disclose all related-party pricing adjustments, management fees, interest, royalties, and intercompany service charges. Omission of cross-border controlled transactions here while making foreign payments is a serious red flag for undisclosed transfer-pricing exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 14 / Line 14 - Taxable Income After Loss Carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after applying deductible prior-year tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: General loss carryforward is 5 years; High-and-New-Technology Enterprises and certain advanced-technology service enterprises may carry losses for 10 years. Losses of the Chinese JV belong solely to the JV and cannot be transferred to or used by the non-resident shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 15 / Line 15 - Applicable Tax Rate and Computed CIT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the statutory 25% rate to the final taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the JV has valid High-and-New-Technology Enterprise status, 15% applies; if small low-profit status applies, 5% effective rate may apply to taxable income up to RMB 3 million. The claimed rate must match the registered status certificate and the detailed calculation must be kept in the return file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 16 / Line 16 - Tax Credits and Reductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for tax-exempt income, foreign tax paid, public welfare investment, and equipment purchase or environmentally qualified expenditures.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign withholding tax on export service income can be credited against CIT with a treaty certification or foreign tax assessment evidence, capped by the Chinese tax on that foreign-source income and carried forward 5 years. The JV must not double-count treaty withholding reductions as foreign tax credits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 17 / Line 17 - Quarterly Prepayments and Final Balance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual quarterly prepayment amounts already paid and the final balance payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quarterlies are due by the 15th day after each quarter-end. At the annual settlement by 31 May, the remaining tax is payable with interest if late. The same return does not compute the dividend withholding tax on profit repatriation; that must be separately withheld at a 10% or treaty-reduced rate when profits are distributed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-filing triggers PRC Tax Collection and Administration Law Article 62: mandatory correction and a fine normally from RMB 2,000 up to RMB 10,000 for severe cases; unpaid tax carries a 0.05% daily late-interest surcharge under Article 32. Under Article 63, fraudulent under-reporting or false filing attracts a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax. If the tax evaded exceeds RMB 100,000 and is more than 10% of the tax payable, Criminal Law Article 201 may apply, with imprisonment for up to 7 years for substantial evasion. Serious tax untrustworthiness also results in public blacklisting and travel restrictions for directors and the legal representative.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding on dividends paid by a Chinese resident enterprise to a non-resident corporate shareholder that has no permanent establishment in China or whose dividends are not effectively connected with such an establishment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Under State Taxation Administration Announcement 2015 No. 60, the non-resident shareholder must submit to the resident JV and to the competent Chinese tax authority: a foreign Tax Residency Certificate, a beneficial-ownership declaration supported by financial substance evidence, proof of direct shareholding satisfying the applicable ownership threshold and holding period (commonly at least 25% held continuously for 12 months under many Chinese DTAs for the 5% dividend rate), the dividend resolution and share register, and a description of no pass-through or conduit arrangement. The withholding agent must file the non-resident withholding declaration using the e-Tax non-resident module; until treaty relief is conclusively substantiated, the statutory 10% must be withheld, and any excess is recoverable by refund or corrected withholding return.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory 10% withholding applies to outbound royalties and interest paid to non-resident enterprises without a China PE. Treaty rates are generally 10% or 5% for royalties depending on IP type and bilateral agreement, and 10% or 0% for interest in certain government-financed or financially-qualified
